title: eludite/semanticTokens/refresh (host to shell)
description: Brief 0066: the language server sent workspace/semanticTokens/refresh (classifications changed, for example after a referenced project changed). The host answers the server null at once and tells the shell with this notification; the shell asks for its open documents' tokens again. eluditeGeneration is the generation current when the refresh arrived; the shell ignores one for another generation.
